verdict.rationale: The evidence shows users can tune some low-level engine parameters. They set the number of GPU-offloaded layers (N_GPU_LAYERS) and split models across CPU and GPU, and the community discusses llama.cpp's mmap-based loading. However, nothing shows user-facing switches to override mmap or enable memory locking. Missing for 10: documented flags to enable or disable mmap, a memory-locking (mlock) option, a reference of overridable engine settings, and hands-on confirmation of overriding those defaults.
